title: 13 Best Mentha Crispa Benefits

benefits.desc: Mentha crispa eases digestion issues because it contains bioactive constituents such as menthol, rosmarinic acid, and terpenoids, which help reduce inflammation and stimulate digestive enzymes. It often arises from poor dietary choices, irregular eating habits, or gastrointestinal disorders. This issue is frequently experienced by individuals with sensitive stomachs, those who consume excessive fatty or spicy foods, or people with conditions like irritable bowel syndrome. Mentha crispa, also known as catnip, has been traditionally used to ease digestion issues due to its calming effect on the digestive system. Its essential oils help reduce inflammation and promote the smooth flow of digestion, offering natural relief for those suffering from digestive discomfort.
benefits.constituents: Mentha crispa eases digestion issues because it contains bioactive constituents such as alkaloids and flavonoids, which possess anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. These compounds help relax the smooth muscles of the gastrointestinal tract, reducing cramping and bloating. The presence of menthol, a volatile oil, further aids in soothing the digestive system. Additionally, flavonoids may enhance gut motility and reduce oxidative stress. Overall, these natural compounds work synergistically to support healthy digestion and alleviate common digestive discomforts.
benefits.study: According to "Evidence-based complementary and alternative medicine : eCAM", Mentha crispa (or Menthofuran present in it) eases digestion issues by showing gastroprotective activity against various stomach ulcers and reducing gastric juice acidity, as well as by increasing the levels of nonprotein sulfhydryl groups and reducing lipidic peroxidation.
